quotes.quote: This bucket contains a zip file with all vulnerabilities across all ecosystems (including withdrawn records) at gs://osv-vulnerabilities/all.zip.
Individual vulnerability records can be found at gs://osv-vulnerabilities/<ECOSYSTEM>/<ID>.json.
Vulnerabilities without an ecosystem (typically withdrawn ones) are exported to the gs://osv-vulnerabilities/[EMPTY]/ directory.
The per-ecosystem files omit the <ecosystem_dir>/ prefix.
the data dump will always contain an ecosystem directory without the :.* suffix (e.g. Alpine).
OSV.dev has stopped exporting entries for ecosystems with prefixes (e.g. All Alpine:.*).
